method.filtering_summary: Live search at about 7:35 AM EAT on 13 sources (12 answered; ReliefWeb failed again) pulled 2,018 postings. 1,483 were older than 7 days or old reposts, 209 senior or excluded titles, 140 not target roles, 46 excluded Kenya, 51 duplicates and 1 already applied. Of the 88 that passed, most were Jobicy bump-dated Canonical reqs or roles shown before (KDCI, WeSoftYou, Canonical Python and Zoftify's other roles were left out as repeats). micro1's own portal was read directly: 21 posts new since yesterday. The eight open to anyone remotely that touch software or data lead the list; country-limited (US, US/Canada/UK/LatAm, US/UK/CAN/AUS) and specialist-licence ones are listed as set aside. Jobgether answered live over HTTP (422 offers, 256 from the last 7 days); three Africa- or worldwide-open roles made the list and on-site or Egypt/Uzbekistan-only ones were dropped. Close reads dropped a LatAm-only role, an unpaid internship, a closed listing and an unclear Power Platform role. Nothing old was carried over.

stories.title: Google's Genie 4 world model adds audio and real-time steering
stories.summary: Google DeepMind released Genie 4 in research preview: more photorealistic interactive worlds, prompts typed mid-simulation to change the scene, and matching real-time audio.
stories.why: World models are the next big AI race after chatbots; useful context for any AI-lab interview.

stories.title: Cassava Technologies becomes an authorised reseller of Anthropic's Claude in Africa
stories.summary: Cassava can now resell access to Claude models through Amazon Bedrock, giving African businesses a local partner for frontier AI.
stories.why: Claude access through an African partner could mean more local AI-integration jobs and clients.

stories.title: VCs will make billions on Anthropic's IPO, but Amazon stands to make far more
stories.summary: Anthropic's S-1 shows no VC firm holds 5%, unusual for a tech IPO; at a $965 billion private valuation, strategic partner Amazon is likely the biggest winner.
stories.why: The Anthropic IPO is the AI story of the year; know the numbers.

stories.title: Anthropic's IPO filing lists more than 90 pages of risk factors
stories.summary: The prospectus goes past boilerplate, covering catastrophic AI risks, competition pressure and the company's clash with the Trump administration.
stories.why: Shows how an AI lab frames safety as a business risk, a common interview theme.

stories.title: Infisical raises a $40M Series B at a $600M valuation
stories.summary: The secrets-management company, which helps firms let AI agents work without handing over credentials, raised a round led by Elad Gil.
stories.why: Agent security is a growing hiring area for developers who build with AI agents.

stories.title: Disruptive raises a $10B fund for at least 10 late-stage bets
stories.summary: The Dallas firm behind bets on Palantir, Groq and ElevenLabs will write checks of up to $1 billion, mainly in AI and defense.
stories.why: More late-stage AI money means bigger hiring at the companies it backs.

stories.title: An Anthropic hiring manager stops giving coding interviews: 'hunger beats tenure'
stories.summary: Felix Rieseberg says he dropped coding challenges because Claude now beats them, and that junior engineers who work well with AI are outpacing longer-tenured coders.
stories.why: Directly relevant to Ben: early-career engineers who are strong with AI tools are what at least one top lab now looks for.

stories.title: Safaricom CEO says M-PESA's next phase is savings, investing and insurance
stories.summary: Peter Ndegwa wants M-PESA to become a place to pay, save, invest and insure; it handles about 150 million transactions a day.
stories.why: Signals where Safaricom's fintech product and engineering work is heading.

stories.title: Safaricom logs 1.25 billion intrusion attempts in FY26
stories.summary: Its sustainability report also counts more than 130,000 security events investigated; Ndegwa calls digital trust a leadership issue, not just IT.
stories.why: Security and trust are growing priorities at Kenya's biggest tech employer.

stories.title: Safaricom says M-PESA created Sh478bn in social value
stories.summary: The same report says 57.8% of M-PESA transactions were free and Safaricom's ecosystem supported more than 1.4 million jobs.
stories.why: Context on M-PESA's scale for Kenyan fintech conversations.

stories.title: NIFCA plans a $250 million technology and AI fund
stories.summary: Nairobi International Financial Centre Authority's Mainga said the fund, about KSh35 billion, would invest in Kenya and the wider continent from next year.
stories.why: More local capital could mean more funded Kenyan startups hiring engineers.
